# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the sequence: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Every one of those commands assumes resistance. You don't stand firm when the ground is level and the skies are clear. You stand firm when the winds howl and your legs are shaking.

Brothers, the world will tell you that strength is toxic, that conviction is narrow, and that discipline is outdated. But God calls you to something higher. He calls you to be awake when others are asleep, to hold the line when others retreat, and to anchor your strength not in your own ego but in the finished work of Christ. Real strength is not loud. It's a man who gets up before dawn, keeps his word, leads his family, and refuses to compromise when no one is watching.

You were not made for comfort. You were made for the fight of faith. So strap on the armor, brother, and step into the day with purpose.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep, thank God for the strength He gives you to stand firm. Then commit one area of your day to Him before you begin.
